jobs.title: Global Technical Talent Lead
jobs.description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. jobs.title: Senior Technical Sourcer
jobs.description: Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games. This position is temporary and US-based only. Discord's Talent team is seeking a strategic Technical Sourcer to support our most complex engineering roles by activating passive candidates. In this role, you'll partner directly with engineering leadership to conduct market intelligence, size talent pools, and execute sophisticated sourcing strategies for hard-to-fill technical roles. You'll be responsible for translating technical requirements into targeted sourcing approaches, building robust candidate pipelines through deep market analysis and personalized outreach, and serving as a trusted advisor on talent availability and competitive dynamics. Success in this role requires a consultative mindset, strong analytical capabilities, and proven expertise in activating passive talent in highly constrained technical markets. Key Responsibilities: Partner strategically with hiring managers and technical leaders to deeply understand role requirements, technical stack nuances, team dynamics, and ideal candidate profiles, translating technical requirements into effective sourcing criteria. Conduct comprehensive total addressable market (TAM) research to size talent pools, identify hiring feasibility, and inform realistic hiring timelines for niche technical roles. jobs.title: People Operations & Workplace Experience Specialist, France
jobs.description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full. About the team The People & Talent team at Airwallex is dedicated to attracting, developing, and enabling the brightest and most ambitious minds to drive our company forward. We are a global, vibrant, and dynamic team focused on creating a positive, inclusive, and high-performing environment where our people can grow and do their best work. Through thoughtful People & Talent programmes, scalable processes, and a deep understanding of our organisation’s needs, we build a collaborative and engaging employee experience that supports Airwallex’s continued growth and success. What you’ll do This role sits at the intersection of People Operations and Workplace Experience for our Paris/Berlin/Barcelona office. You will act as a critical “boots on the ground” partner, ensuring core HR operations for the EMEA team run smoothly while helping build a strong, engaging in-office culture during a period of rapid growth for EMEA. jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Manager
jobs.description: Notre mission ⚖️ Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe. Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence. Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée. Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance. Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales. Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction. Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début. En collaboration directe avec les managers des différentes équipes, tu seras chargé.e de comprendre leurs besoins et de les aider à recruter les personnes les plus adaptées. Il s'agit d'un poste central chez Doctrine, et tu contribueras directement à notre croissance. Tu feras partie de l'équipe People et sera rattaché.e à notre DRH, Gabrielle de Luppé, et en plus des hiring managers, tu travailleras au quotidien avec quatre autres TAM qui connaissent parfaitement Doctrine. Nous te proposons de développer ta connaissance des métiers d'une entreprise tech , et de construire progressivement ton autonomie sur toutes les étapes du recrutement, du sourcing au closing. Tu contribueras aussi à nos initiatives marque employeur au sens large, et nous aideras à améliorer les process de recrutement de Doctrine. jobs.description: Location: Remote Type: Contract / Part-time Commitment: 10-20 hours per week Compensation: Up to 40 USD / hr Project duration: 2 months , with potential extension About the role We create high-quality STEM training data for frontier AI models that is directly used in training and evaluation workflows at leading AI labs. We are looking for experts in Chemistry to design advanced, deterministic problems with exactly one verifiable correct answer. jobs.title: Senior People Operations Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description: bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you. Your Role bunch is around 155 people across Berlin, London, and Amsterdam, and Luxembourg, on the way to roughly 200 in 2027. That means four legal entities, four payroll providers, different sets of people systems to reconcile, different compliance environments. Right now our People operations run 50% on effort. We want them to run mostly on systems. We also want our people data to be trustworthy enough that headcount, attrition, and hiring numbers are the same in every room they're quoted in. This person will own the operational and data backbone that the rest of the People function depends on. Your role Take full, end-to-end ownership of core People Operations topics — including onboarding, offboarding, contracts, leaves, absence, payroll, immigration cases and documentation — from decision-making through execution. Design, build, and roll out automated, AI-supported workflows and integrations across our tools — including Personio (HRIS) and Notion — to eliminate manual work and connect our systems. Coordinate monthly payroll across Germany, the UK and the Netherlands and in the near future, Luxembourg, with our external providers. You own data accuracy, deadlines and the provider relationships — the providers own the processing. Maintain the compliance calendar and the documentation behind it, working with external counsel where local employment law is involved. Manage and support our full workforce across multiple contract types and locations, ensuring correct setup, documentation, and ongoing administration for each. jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner
jobs.description: CAIS is the pioneer in democratizing access to and education about alternative investments for independent financial advisors, empowering them to engage and transact with leading asset managers on a massive scale through a wide variety of alternative investment products and technology solutions. CAIS provides financial advisors with a broad selection of alternative investment strategies, including hedge funds, private equity, private credit, real estate, digital assets, and structured notes. CAIS also delivers industry-leading technology, operational efficiency, and world-class client service throughout the pre-trade, trade, and post-trade experience. CAIS serves over 2,500 wealth management firms that support more than 65,000 financial advisors who oversee approximately $8.5 trillion in end-client assets. About the Role   CAIS is seeking a Talent Acquisition Partner to lead technology hiring from initial brief through accepted offer, focusing on quality, consistency, and speed of hiring. This is an individual contributor role for an accomplished technical recruiter who combines exceptional sourcing and market-mapping capability with sound judgement, commercial understanding, and credibility with senior technology leaders. You will recruit across Engineering, Product, Machine Learning, Data, Corporate Technology, and Security, and flex into other areas of the business as priorities shift. The role is based in London, with hiring across our teams in the United Kingdom and United States.   We are particularly interested in recruiters who have successfully managed a broad portfolio of technical searches at the same time, rather than specializing exclusively in one discipline. Experience in one or more of the functions above is valuable. Candidates from any technology environment are welcome, and those with financial services or fintech experience are likely to bring relevant market understanding. Experience across every discipline or sector is not expected. &

jobs.title: Head of HR
jobs.description: WHO ARE WE? Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz , All About Cookies , and OnlyInYourState . We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies. Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment. We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries. WHY JOIN US? You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato . Base salary: $170,000 to $190,000. Plus an annual bonus paid as a flat amount rather than a percentage of base. Launch Potato is about 200 people, profitable, and growing. The performance management system that got us here was built by our SVP of Talent, and he still runs it. That system becomes yours. You're inheriting something that works. There's a levels framework, a rating scale, a calibration process, and managers who have been through several cycles. It got us to 200 people. Your job is deciding what carries forward and change-managing the rest, across an org that moves fast and adopts new processes. We want someone who'll find the version that works and then hold it there while the company gets good at it. If you want to own a function, make it extraordinary, and be judged on whether it actually got better, keep reading. Why This Seat Real ownership, immediately. jobs.title: HR Business Partner
jobs.description: Een senior HR-rol waarin strategie, ondernemerschap en mensgericht werken écht samenkomen. In deze vacature als HR Business Partner bij Koninklijke Van Wijhe Verf in Zwolle krijg je veel ruimte om HR verder te professionaliseren en zelfstandig projecten te realiseren. Een fulltime of parttime baan bij een duurzame, innovatieve werkgever waar jouw advies zichtbaar impact heeft. Taken Maak het verschil als HR Business Partner in Zwolle Dankzij jouw brede HR-expertise krijgen leidinggevenden een stevige sparringpartner en ontwikkelt HR mee met de ambities van de organisatie. Als HR Business Partner adviseer je zelfstandig jouw klantgroepen over strategische, tactische én operationele HR-vraagstukken. Je beweegt gemakkelijk tussen organisatieontwikkeling, verandertrajecten en concrete personeelscasuïstiek. Daarbij kijk je kritisch naar bestaande processen en vertaal je ideeën naar concrete verbeteringen. Je werkt nauw samen met de HR Manager en andere HR-collega’s en hebt veel contact met leidinggevenden binnen onder meer Koninklijke Van Wijhe Verf en Mooij Verf. Ook zet je HR en financiële data gericht in om keuzes te onderbouwen en pak je zelfstandig projecten op rondom thema’s als Strategische personeelsinzet, medewerker ontwikkeling, duurzame inzetbaarheid en organisatie- en teamontwikkeling. Kortom, jij pakt de regie bij het: adviseren en ondersteunen van leidinggevenden bij strategische, tactische en operationele HR-vraagstukken; begeleiden van organisatieontwikkeling en verandertrajecten; zelfstandig initiëren en realiseren van HR-projecten rondom onder andere strategische HR, ontwikkeling en duurzame inzetbaarheid; analyseren van HR-data en vertalen van inzichten naar concrete adviezen en verbeteringen; professionaliseren van HR-processen en versterken van de brede inzetbaarheid binnen het HR-team.
